editorial.blurb: A neighborhood gem serving generous portions of fresh, craveable Chinese fare at prices that feel like a steal.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the lunch specials for exceptional value and huge portions—customize your fried rice (vegetarian is a popular choice) and ask about any substitutions like the taro smoothie if your first pick isn't available; the staff will call ahead to confirm.
signatureDishes: Shrimp egg foo young dinner combo
